exposure: Prosthetic heart valve replacement secondary to rheumatic heart disease
cohort: 100 consecutive pregnant women with valvular heart disease or prosthetic heart valve replacement secondary to rheumatic heart disease referred to a department of cardiology.
finding: Pregnant women with rheumatic heart disease, particularly those with higher modified WHO and CARPREG risk stratification scores or severe valve lesions, carry a high risk for both maternal and fetal adverse events.
mod_finding: All 4 mitral valve replacement surgeries performed during delivery were concomitant with lower segment caesarean section (LSCS).
